settings.ggxWuLPs741_text: The Basics of Coconut Oil for Oil Pulling
settings.ggYfNU3UyuB_text:
Oil pulling is an ancient Ayurvedic practice that has recently become popular because of its supposed benefits to the oral cavity. While this practice entails using coconut oil for a longer period of oral cleaning, the variety of coconut oil available may be overwhelming. So, what's the best coconut oil for oil pulling?
 

Now, let’s examine all coconut oils to determine which is best for oil pulling in oral care!

Coconut oil has been recommended as one of the best oils for oil pulling since it has many unique benefits for the human body. Coconut oil is rich in lauric acid, a potent antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory substance; it can be used effectively as an agent against the adverse bacteria in the mouth, preventing the formation of plaques and promoting gum health.
settings.ggQQstHvxMk_text: Different Kinds of Coconut Oil for Oil Pulling
settings.gggAvq1w7r8_text:
1. Virgin Coconut Oil

Virgin coconut oil, which is cold-pressed and unrefined, has many nutritional and cosmetic benefits and does not lose its taste and smell profile. Although it provides great gustative values at room temperature, the solidification may occur less favorably for oil pulling.

2. Refined Coconut Oil

It has a mild and pleasant taste and aroma, which is why it is used in cooking and oil pulling. Also, because it is in a liquid form, it stays easily within reach and is convenient!

3. Fractionated Coconut Oil

With its lower melting point, consistent liquid form, and neutral taste, this oil remains liquid at wide temperature ranges. As it makes oil pulling easier.

Select the Most Appropriate Coconut Oil for Oil Pulling

 

Consider these factors when selecting the appropriate coconut oil for oil pulling:

Taste: Virgin coconut oil offers the full, delicious coconut flavor; refined or fractionated versions may be more appropriate for those preferring something with less of an authentic aroma and taste.

Consistency: Fractionated coconut oil remains liquid at even cooler temperatures, making it the optimal option for regular use.

Purity: Opt for organic cold-pressed coconut oil whenever possible for optimal quality.
